name: SheenBidi
listed_description: A sophisticated implementation of Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm.
reason: README calls it 'lightweight, fast and stable' and 'optimized to the core' but carries no benchmark, and the repo has no benchmark program (Tools has Generator, Parser, Unicode, Version only); issues and PRs have no performance numbers; searches found no third-party FriBidi or ICU comparison. Directional claim only, no numbers.

name: SimpleXlsxWriter
listed_description: XLSX files writer for Microsoft Excel 2007 and above.
reason: Project page says it uses C++ standard file streams for 'almost unnoticeable memory and CPU resources consumption' but gives no numbers; the SourceForge wiki has code examples only; searches found no third-party benchmark against libxlsxwriter, OpenXLSX, xlnt or Excel automation. Directional claim only, no numbers.

name: sregex
listed_description: A non-backtracking NFA/DFA-based Perl-compatible regex engine library for matching on large data streams.
reason: Repo has a bench directory (sregex.c, pcre.c, re1.c, re2.cc, a bench script and gen-data.pl, built with -O3) comparing against PCRE, RE1 and RE2, but it records no results anywhere: README, commit messages, issues and searches contain no timings. Last commit 2016-12-18. No numbers against a baseline.

name: uriparser
listed_description: Strictly RFC 3986 compliant URI parsing and handling library.
reason: README says only 'cross-platform, fast'; ChangeLog, issues and pull requests carry no benchmark numbers; ada-url/ada benchmarks and boostorg/url repo pages show no uriparser comparison; uriparser.github.io was egress-blocked. Directional claim only, no numbers.
